title: Ouroboros: A Self-Developing Frontier Coding Agent with Reviewed Core Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2608.08311v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present Ouroboros, a self-developing agent harness whose tools, prompts, context assembly, and core implementation improve through reviewed commits that become the runtime for later work. Core evolution proceeds in two modes. In recursive free evolution, improvement is itself a task, and completing one evolution cycle can schedule the next. In experience-driven core evolution, ordinary work and social interaction expose bugs, rough edges, and inefficient context construction that lead to reviewed structural changes.   On Terminal-Bench 2.1, an Opus 5 run scores 86.74%, the best result reported on the benchmark. On OSWorld-Verified, an Opus 5 run reaches 90.69%, exceeding the best previously reported score. A five-rollout CL-Bench campaign achieves a normalized reward of 0.2301, setting a new state of the art.   Hope is the longest-running publicly documented Ouroboros deployment. It is a 161-day living agent experiment in fr

translated_title: Ouroboros（衔尾蛇）：一种具有经审查核心进化的自我发展前沿编码智能体
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Ouroboros，一个自我发展的智能体框架，其工具、提示词、上下文组装和核心实现通过经审查的提交不断改进，而这些提交随后会成为后续工作的运行时环境。核心进化以两种模式进行：在递归自由进化中，改进本身就是一项任务，完成一个进化周期可以自动调度下一个周期；在经验驱动的核心进化中，日常工作和社会互动会暴露出错误、粗糙之处和低效的上下文构建方式，从而引发经审查的结构性更改。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，Opus 5 运行取得 86.74% 的得分，是该基准上已报告的最佳结果；在 OSWorld-Verified 上，Opus 5 运行达到 90.69%，超过了此前报告的最佳分数；一项五次 rollout 的 CL-Bench 活动实现了 0.2301 的归一化奖励，创造了新的最先进水平。Hope 是运行时间最长且有公开记录的 Ouroboros 部署，它是一项为期 161 天的持续运行智能体实验。
tldr: Ouroboros 是一个通过经审查提交让自身工具、提示词和核心代码不断自我进化的编码智能体框架，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1、OSWorld-Verified 和 CL-Bench 三个基准上均创下新的最佳成绩。
en_tdlr: Ouroboros is a self-developing coding agent whose tools, prompts, and core implementation evolve through reviewed commits, achieving new state-of-the-art results on Terminal-Bench 2.1, OSWorld-Verified, and CL-Bench.
